definitions.explanation: Taking in and housing people or things in a facility. Also refers to the capacity of a venue.
Confining people in a facility, such as a detention center or internment camp.

examples.japanese: このホールは500{人|にん}{収容|しゅうよう}できる。
{避難者|ひなんしゃ}を{体育館|たいいくかん}に{収容|しゅうよう}した。
examples.english: The evacuees were housed in the gymnasium.

examples.japanese: スタジアムの{収容|しゅうよう}{人数|にんずう}は5{万人|まんにん}だ。
{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}は{施設|しせつ}に{収容|しゅうよう}された。
examples.english: The suspect was detained in a facility.

examples.japanese: {戦時中|せんじちゅう}、{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}が{収容所|しゅうようじょ}に{送|おく}られた。
examples.english: During the war, many people were sent to internment camps.

examples.japanese: {入国管理局|にゅうこくかんりきょく}の{収容|しゅうよう}{施設|しせつ}における{処遇|しょぐう}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: The treatment at immigration detention facilities has become an issue.

notes:
{収容|しゅうよう} has two distinct senses with different connotations: sense 1 (capacity/shelter) is neutral, while sense 2 (detention/internment) carries a negative connotation of forced confinement.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: [people/things]を{収容|しゅうよう}する

SENSE 1 — CAPACITY/SHELTER:
- {収容|しゅうよう}{人数|にんずう}: seating/accommodation capacity
- {収容|しゅうよう}{能力|のうりょく}: capacity, ability to hold
- 500{人|にん}{収容|しゅうよう}: holds 500 people
- {避難者|ひなんしゃ}を{収容|しゅうよう}する: to shelter evacuees

SENSE 2 — DETENTION/INTERNMENT:
- {収容所|しゅうようじょ}: detention/internment camp
- {収容|しゅうよう}{施設|しせつ}: detention facility
- {強制|きょうせい}{収容|しゅうよう}: forced internment

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news, legal, and administrative contexts. In everyday speech, {入|い}れる or {泊|と}める would be more natural for sense 1.
